gloss: business day; working day; day of operation

definitions.gloss: business day; working day; day of operation
definitions.explanation: A day on which a business, office, or institution is open and operating. Used in commerce, banking, and service industries to distinguish from holidays and days off.

examples.japanese: {営業日|えいぎょうび}は{月曜|げつよう}から{金曜|きんよう}までです。
examples.english: Business days are Monday through Friday.

examples.japanese: {発送|はっそう}は{翌|よく}{営業日|えいぎょうび}になります。
examples.english: Shipping will be on the next business day.

examples.japanese: お{届|とど}けまで3{営業日|えいぎょうび}ほどかかります。
{年末年始|ねんまつねんし}は{営業日|えいぎょうび}が{変更|へんこう}になる{場合|ばあい}がございます。
examples.english: Business days may change during the year-end and New Year period.

notes:
Extremely common in commercial and administrative contexts. Appears constantly on websites, store signs, and official notices. Distinguished from 定休日 (regular day off) and 休業日 (closed day).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {翌|よく}{営業日|えいぎょうび}: next business day
- ○{営業日|えいぎょうび}{以内|いない}: within ○ business days
- {営業日|えいぎょうび}カレンダー: business day calendar
- {営業日|えいぎょうび}{変更|へんこう}: change in business days

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {平日|へいじつ}: weekday — calendar-based (Mon-Fri), not business-specific
- {定休日|ていきゅうび}: regular day off — the scheduled closing day of a business
- {休業日|きゅうぎょうび}: closed day — a day when business is suspended
